Sea Bass Fillet

About This Entry

Sea bass fillet is delicate with clean flavor — Mediterranean staple. Vermentino, Provence rosé, and light Italian reds match herbs and olive oil.

Beginner Guide

European sea bass (branzino) is the same species as whole branzino in this catalog.

FAQ

What is Sea Bass Fillet?
European sea bass (branzino) is the same species as whole branzino in this catalog.
How should Sea Bass Fillet be cooked for best results?
Do not overcook lean fillets; shellfish should be opaque and firm. Rest fish briefly before serving.
